what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Bolivia in the United States: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 5502 Bolivian asylum seekers in the United States, 81.5% of all asylum seekers from Bolivia.
Refugees from Bolivia, a separate group, live mostly in the United States, Canada, France and Ireland.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Bolivia, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 55 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 5969, at the end of 2024, and was slightly lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for the United States only.
